focus.title: Enterprise onboarding. A more connected SaintSal™.
focus.body: Connecting company knowledge, human oversight and practical AI tools across desktop, mobile and web.

updates.title: Enterprise momentum in education
updates.body: Ryan publicly announced a signed enterprise client in India’s education sector and the next phase of user onboarding.

updates.title: SaintSal™ across your screens
updates.body: The official download hub lists Mac, Windows, iPhone, iPad and the browser extension, alongside the web experience.

updates.title: Company knowledge, with people in control
updates.body: SaintSal’s public product materials describe company knowledge, configurable guardrails and model routing as foundations of the experience.

updates.title: Founder vision. Technical leadership.
updates.body: Ryan introduced Ritik Rohan as co-founder, CTO and Director of Technology Development in his public company announcement.
